summary: SPI transfer timeout on ARM64 platform with DMA enabled
description:
SPI transfers intermittently timeout on the i.MX8 platform when DMA is enabled. The spi-imx driver hangs in wait_for_completion_timeout() and never receives the DMA completion callback.

Log output:
  spi_imx 30820000.spi: I/O Error in DMA RX
  spi_master spi0: failed to transfer one message from queue

Disabling DMA (spi-imx.dma=0) works around the issue. Suspected race between DMA completion IRQ and SPI controller status polling.
